review.assessment: The change introduces a new file with a stub implementation of `slugify` that ignores input and always returns an empty string. Consequently, all provided unit tests fail because the function does not perform any logic to convert titles into URL slugs.

findings.actual: Returns "" (empty string) instead of a slug
findings.defect: Unimplemented `slugify`: The function returns an empty string for valid input.
